text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Omg, Zephyr, the way you talk is
straight up lit!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
You know, you're always like "windy
whoosh,
easty squall"? The wind lingo?
You gotta teach
me how you do it!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Umm, I'm not sure I can... All I'm doing is
stringing
words to a kite during a sudden
gale.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yasss! No clue what that means, but I
totally vibe
with it!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Well, you might feel that way... but
exposing your
heart is like stirring up the
midsummer storm.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Oh, uhhh... So like... it's super cringe if you hit hard? Nah, that's cool! It's fire!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
It's chill to use this? Legit, so fresh!
Wooo!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, yes. But... you don't need my
permission.
Just let yourself get carried...
where the winds
take you.
